# Compiler Testing

## Overview

Compiler [testing](./testing.md) utilizes a fictional [sample domain](./sample-domain.md) universe designed specifically to stress-test the compiler. This simulated ecosystem includes invented companies, recurring characters, products, and intentional contradictions to exercise cross-linking, analytics, and human review capabilities.

## Key Details

The compiler testing sample domain encompasses several organizations and their respective offerings:

- **[Aurora Labs](./aurora-labs.md) (`aurora`)**: Open [IoT](./iot.md) mesh [sensors](./sensors.md) focusing on products like the [Nova Widget](./nova-widget.md) (soil moisture and temperature with a pebble enclosure) and the [MeshSync protocol](./meshsync-protocol.md) (a local mesh featuring no mandatory cloud). Key personnel include [Mira Chen](./aurora-nova-widget.md) ([Firmware](./firmware.md) lead) and Jonah Park ([Hardware](./hardware.md)).
- **[TeaBuddy](./teabuddy.md) (`teabuddy`)**: [BLE](./ble.md) smart tea timers centered around the [TeaBuddy Puck](./teabuddy.md) (utilizing a CR2032 battery, BLE, and haptic + LED feedback) alongside an iOS app. Key personnel include Sam Rivera (Firmware), Alex Kim (UX / interviews), and Jamie Lo (QA).
- **[Nova Health](./aurora-nova-widget.md) (`nova-health`)**: Clinical wearables manufacturer featuring the PulsePatch, which shares no firmware with MeshSync.
- **GreenGrid Energy (`greengrid`)**: Home energy mesh company centered around the GreenGrid Hub, which is designated for exploratory integration only.

Additional recurring characters in the procedural generator cast include Elena Voss, Priya Nair, Marcus Webb, Tina Okonkwo, and Dev Singh. Competitor products within the dataset include the [SenseNode SN-400](./sensenode-sn-400.md) (an IP67, subscription-based [LoRaWAN](./lorawan.md) device).
